phase_name: Study Mode UX Completion - Phase 2: Spec Gap Closure

completed.summary: Added executable Playwright specs with POMs for study and practice pages. 8 new files (PracticePage POM, StudyPage POM, practice.spec.ts, study.spec.ts, catalog, workflows). 24 e2e tests exercise preflop matrix, postflop strategy, full hand journey, practice exercise types, timed drill, spaced repetition.

Added blue (#3A6EA5) coloring for call-primary hand matrix cells. Normalized action keys in getCellColor (raise_2.5bb/raise_3bb → raise) for robust ACTION_COLORS lookup. Fixed fallback path: non-raise cells default to GRAY (fold) instead of BLUE when solver API is unavailable. Existing solver mode already handled call→BLUE via ACTION_COLORS (pre-existing), action normalization and fallback fix complete the implementation. 368+25 tests pass, live 200.

localStorage-backed stats bar with accuracy/streak, by-position/by-action breakdown, New Session button, 30min session timeout. Already implemented in commit 3937256. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Convert courses listing page from light theme (white cards, #aafbb2 green) to GTO Wizard dark design system: var(--panel) cards, var(--border) borders, var(--green) (#00C853) accents, var(--text)/var(--muted) text. Updated stats summary, filter panel, course cards, sidebar, loading/error states. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Fixed progress endpoint 500 error (UserProgressResponse.id Optional[str]), restarted API to populate lesson content with real markdown. Course detail page shows lessons with content, progress tracking works end-to-end (mark complete, view progress). 387 tests pass, build clean, live 200.
Replaced Math.random() bar heights with real selectedHandData.equity values. Bar height = Math.max(4, equity * 55), showing actual per-hand equity from solver API.

Created /leaderboard page with period filter (all-time/weekly/daily), table with rank/player/score/accuracy/hands/EV-loss columns, current user highlight with YOU badge, medal icons for top 3, empty/error/loading states. Added period filter support to GET /api/v1/quiz/leaderboard backend. 368 tests pass, build clean, live returns 200 with 0 JS errors.

Postflop action selection feedback: selected button highlights with green border/glow, GTO-recommended action shows ✓ GTO badge, feedback text below action row shows 'Correct!' or 'Suboptimal (EV gap: X.X bb)', 'Try Again' button resets selection, 'Continue to Next Street' button advances street. Unselected buttons disabled after pick. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Timed Drill mode: per-spot countdown timer (configurable 30s/60s/120s) with visual ⏱️ indicator, auto-advance on expiry (records as incorrect), response time tracking with speed bonus scoring (up to +50 pts per spot), drill summary with Score/Avg Time/Accuracy. Timer duration selector in setup. Spaced Repetition shows 'coming soon' notice. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Verified right sidebar analysis tabs are fully implemented: Overview/Table/Equity chart main tabs, Hand/Summary/Filters/Actions/Blockers sub-tabs, aggregate action frequencies with combo counts, card removal analysis. Already committed in d980026. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200. Advancing to next task.

Replaced flat position buttons with spot card bar: 6 horizontal scrollable position cards (UTG/HJ/CO/BTN/SB/BB), active card shows 'Take action' prompt + action buttons (Fold/Raise X/Allin Y/Call for SB/BB), minimized cards show compact view. GTO recommendation highlighted with ✓ badge. Raise sizing: 2.5bb UTG/HJ/CO/BTN, 3.5bb SB/BB. Call only for SB/BB. 368 tests pass, TS clean, build clean.

Implemented spaced repetition mode with SM-2 algorithm: per-spot easeFactor/interval tracking, localStorage persistence, due-for-review count in setup, next review time in session sidebar, summary with Due Now stat and Next Review Schedule section. 368 tests pass, build clean.

Verified API is already running via systemd service (gto-api.service) on port 8001, auto-restarts (Restart=always), starts on boot (enabled). Disabled duplicate broken service (gto-wizard-api.service) that was conflict-looping on the same port. uv sync --group runtime passes. API health 200, web health 200, live 200, 368 tests pass.

Verified fix-strategy-lookup is already complete. The dict type mismatch bug was fixed in commit 86e37bb (pass StrategyFilters instead of raw dict, fix store_strategy cache metadata). Strategy data auto-seeded on API startup — preflop and flop lookups return valid GTO ranges at all stack depths. Endpoint returns 200 for valid queries, 404 for missing data. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Board cards as styled playing cards, street breadcrumb, all 10 action buttons (CHECK/BET 33-125%/FOLD/CALL/RAISE 50-100%/ALL IN) with chip amount+pot%+GTO frequency, position columns with active green highlight, GTO comparison overlay, Configure Spot panel. 368 tests pass, build clean, live 200.

Solutions frontend page exists at apps/web/src/app/solutions/page.tsx with: search/filter bar (position, board type, street), solution cards showing board/position/stack/top actions with frequency bars, click-to-expand detail panel with GTO strategy breakdown (hands or actions), Practice This Spot cross-navigation to /study, dark design system. Functional 2-7 Triple Draw equity calculator with Monte Carlo simulation (1K-100K samples), two 5-card hand inputs with card validation and duplicate detection, hand evaluator with correct 2-7 ranking (lower wins, straights/flushes count against), equity bar with % display, hand category names, How 2-7 TD Works rules section. PLO4 equity calculator already built (229 lines, re-exported by /plo4/page.tsx from ../plo/page.tsx). Monte Carlo sim, 4-card hand input, optional board, equity bar with % and hand strength. OOP EV column in study Table tab already uses real solver equity data (weighted average across all hands: h.equity * h.frequency / sum(frequency)) converted to bb EV via (avgEquity - 0.5) * 3. Displayed as +X.X green / -X.X red, falls back to '—' when solver unavailable. Verified: study/page.tsx lines 398-415 compute from real rangeData, lines 2217-2223 render correctly. No Math.random() in OOP EV path. 393 tests pass, live 200.

StrategyHeatmap component NaN filtering already implemented in commit fee7e61. Object.values(strategy) entries filtered to exclude null/undefined/NaN/Infinity before computing avg frequency and avg EV. Falls back to null/'—' when no valid data. Verified: StrategyHeatmap.tsx lines 710-723 filter, lines 876-892 display safely. 393 tests pass, live 200.

Full study progress persistence: POST /api/v1/study/progress (hand, position, stack_depth, action_chosen, action_gto, correct, user_id), GET /api/v1/study/progress?user_id= returns aggregated stats (total_hands, correct_hands, overall_accuracy, current_streak, best_streak, by_position, by_action, recent_sessions, last_week). Add 67 vitest component tests for study components: ActionSelector (14 tests), PostflopTraining helpers (38 tests), handMatrixLogic (15 tests). vitest.config.ts with React + jsdom. No production code changes (6 export keywords). 67/67 pass, 368/368 existing pass.

Enable Playwright video recording for ALL tests (video: 'on'). Combined commits 913e79d (retain-on-failure) + 5a72beb (on). Helps debug flaky E2E tests. Config-only change, 1 line.
